newsitem.title: USA: Equity Residential buys five properties.
newsitem.headline: Equity Residential buys five properties.

text.p: Equity Residential Properties Trust said Wednesday it acquired five properties consisting of 2,188 units for a total purchase price of about $167 million.
Club at Tanasbourne is a 352-unit property in Hillsboro, Ore., a suburb of Portland.
Foxchase, a 260-unit property in Grand Prairie, Texas, a Dallas suburb, was purchased for $8.3 million.
The company acquired two properties in Chattanooga, Tenn. for a total of $15 million.
La Mirage is a 1,070-unit property in the Mission Valley area of San Diego, Calif. The purchase price was $129.75 million.
Nationwide, Equity Residential owns or has investments in 350 properties in 32 states.
